verdict.rationale: Missive documents its own search with Type (Internal/External) and Date range filters. The command bar can search all messages, contacts, or messages inside a specific label. That covers basic filtering and scoping, but little else of the power-user story is evidenced. missing for 10: search operators/query syntax, result ranking, speed/performance evidence, explicit coverage of full mail history, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history

citations.quote: The Type (Internal / External) and Date range filters in search no longer stay greyed out until you enter a search term.
you can search in all of your messages, in your contacts or in the messages inside a specific label.
